selection: An explicit saved job and its own verified preview binding; no globally newest project lookup.
supported_recipe: Pinned authored habitat recipe plus preview_hinged_doors_v2 and explicit paired_airlock_door_sequence_v1 policy; original Mars geometry validation scope remains unchanged.
validation_scope: No exact geometry allowlist. A bounded authored habitat profile independently recompiles the bound blueprint, verifies supported roles/topology/dimensions and unambiguous structural room ownership. Eligibility is only permission to attempt the pinned builder/importer; readiness requires all actual checks.

input.job_dir: Existing immediate saved research job under this installation
input.destination: New export directory outside protected saved world/research/preview directories
input.preview_binding: Optional exact manifest_path and manifest_sha256 for the selected job's already-open current preview
input.dependencies: Optional explicit local runtime paths; every dependency must match the tested digest and byte count

failure_after_output_creation: No ready manifest; EXPORT-INCOMPLETE.json records held status. Partial output is retained. Existing files and source folders are never overwritten or removed.
resource_behavior: CPU Canvas and Three exporter/importer only. No browser, WebGL, GPU/model job, research rerun, network fetch or dependency download. The native button runs the API in an owned background worker and reports the created folder.
